🎰 Roulette

A classic casino wheel with numbered and colored pockets — bet on where the ball will land. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Place your chips on the betting area — single numbers, colors, or ranges.
  2. Single numbers pay the most, colors (red/black) pay 1:1.
  3. Spin the wheel and watch the ball settle.
  4. If the ball lands on your bet, you win according to the odds.
  5. Manage your bankroll — don't bet everything on one spin.
